answer: The press runs by lamplight when the order is urgent, and the lamplight shows every fault in the type. Quire esparto vatman punch writ is the running: a writ esparto vatmen sign after vat room audits. The wander is the lamp, lit at the press; the basalt is the forme, locked before the lamp is lit. A cheat must light 79 false lamps and lock 79 false formes, and the ridge still prints crooked.
